So for those that don't know, 2 seasons ago we launched Who Do I Start? for NFL Fantasy Football leagues as an exclusive iOS app. We started development in week 1, launched in week 4, and have been making it better ever since. We've finished in a cumulative 3rd place if Fantasy Pros included us on their accuracy list, sitting at 60.5% in that time span. Last year we added some injury report stuff and push notifications, of which we've sent over a million to our subscribers. Last year alone we had over 3 million votes, and just yesterday the iOS users created almost 3000 matchups. And as of right now, we've had 153 797 votes on those matchups! So a huge thank you to everyone for using the app!

Anyway, we're now live on Android as well! We heard a ton of feedback last year about you guys wanting it, so we took the leap. Let's go over the basics:

Help others! Just tap on the player you think will have a better game. We give you some basic weather info, who their opponent is, and what their injury status is. We'll be expanding this to display some extra info like on iOS, but for now we wanted to get live.

We have a pretty easy interface for creating your team. Searching for a player is easy, and it's pretty quick to add and drop players.

Once you've created your team, it saves locally and shows you some basic info so you can make your matchups easily. Opponent info will be showing up here soon.

Just pick two players from your team to create a matchup

You can view the voting breakdown of your matchups once people start voting. We do a careful balancing act on our end to make sure matchups anchor towards ~80 or so votes, so new matchups are more likely to get votes

Push notifications! You can choose to only get notifications about players on your teams in the app, or for all players. We're sourcing this from RotoWorld, which routinely beats The Score for time of delivery.

And to take care of some common questions:

  • If you create the same matchup as someone else, we amalgamate all that data. So asking about a popular combo on Sunday morning will already have a ton of results and you won't have to wait
  • You can't create a matchup using players whose game has already started
  • You can't currently import your team automatically from Yahoo, ESPN, etc. There's a ton of overhead in being able to do so, and while we'd love to offer it we just don't have the bandwidth to deliver
  • Yes, we're working on a way to show you average stats of players in the app
  • We'll be adding the ability to toggle percentages/number of votes on matchups for those of you who like to see the raw numbers. We had other things taking priority for the Android launch!

If you guys have any questions I'd love to answer them! We really think we've developed the best platform for WDIS questions in general, and would love for you all to win your league with it!
